_comment: Merge the 'hooks' object below into ~/.claude/settings.json. Adjust VAULT_ROOT path to match your setup.
_setup: Replace C:/Users/nhata/PycharmProjects/llm-wiki with your actual repo path.

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]] && ([[ "$FILE" == */vault/wiki/* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == */vault/papers/* ]]); then python "C:/Users/nhata/PycharmProjects/llm-wiki/hooks/update-modified.py" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Auto-update 'updated' timestamp after editing a wiki or papers note

hooks.command: bash -c 'if command -v qmd &>/dev/null; then qmd embed -c llm-wiki 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

_notes.QMD_setup: To enable semantic search: npm install -g @tobilu/qmd && qmd collection add ./vault --name llm-wiki && qmd context add llm-wiki 'Quant trading research vault' && qmd embed
_notes.why_no_PreToolUse_validation: Validation as PreToolUse hook can be noisy; prefer running standalone audit instead
